Kiwi (Korean Intelligent Word Identifier)
https://github.com/bab2min/Kiwi

License: LGPL-2.1-or-later

This directory contains the official Kiwi morphological analysis model
(v0.23.2, cong/base) used by Mal · 韓語文法筆記本.

The Kiwi WASM binding (vendor/kiwi-nlp) is the npm package `kiwi-nlp`
(LGPL-2.1-or-later). Source: https://github.com/bab2min/Kiwi
